description:
[Tasks] The hiring team's follow-up tasks: mine, created by me or all; by candidate, position, assignee, status or due date; with counts.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

assignee_profile_id.description: Only tasks assigned to this user (profile.id). Without candidate_id and position_id this lists a team member's tasks: owners only.

candidate_id.description: Only tasks about this candidate (profile_interview.id), including those about one of their applications.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

due.description: Only open tasks overdue, due today (company time zone), upcoming, or without a due date (none).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

position_id.description: Only tasks about this position (position_def_set.id) or interview (interview_def_set.id) itself.

scope.description: mine (assigned to you, default), created (created by you) or all (every task of the company; owners only).

name: list_tasks
title: List tasks
